generation_parents.algorithm: This heuristic scores each unvisited customer using a scale-free angular sweep rule: it ranks candidates by the cosine of the angle formed at the current node between the depot direction and the candidate direction, preferring customers that continue smoothly in the current travel direction while penalizing sharp turns back toward the depot, combined with a capacity-aware term that favors high-demand customers early in the route so the route packs well before returning.
